name: AutoOS – Car Dealer Service & Insurance Reminders, Test-Drive Follow-ups and Post-Service NPS Recovery

parameters.content:
## 🚘 AutoOS – Car Dealer Reminders & Service NPS

For car dealerships in India whose service advisors still call customers from a register. Free services get missed, insurance lapses to another agent, test-drive leads go cold after one follow-up, and an unhappy customer's first complaint is a one-star Google review.

### How it works
Every morning the workflow checks each vehicle for service due by kilometres or months, and insurance nearing expiry. It sends WhatsApp reminders at set stages and never repeats a stage. Test-drive leads get AI-written follow-ups on days 1, 3, 7 and 14, and cold leads are flagged to the salesperson.

When your DMS closes a job card, the vehicle record is updated, and three hours later the customer gets a short NPS survey. Detractors go straight to the service manager with an AI summary and an apology to the customer. Promoters are asked for a Google review.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Google Sheet with **Vehicles**, **Test Drive Leads**, **Reminder Log**, **Service Jobs** and **NPS Log** tabs.
2. Connect WhatsApp Business Cloud, Google Sheets, Gmail and OpenAI.
3. Edit **Set AutoOS Config** with your dealer name, links, service intervals and manager numbers, and replace the `REPLACE_WITH_…` IDs.
4. Set your n8n domain in the NPS link inside **Normalize Job Card**, and point your DMS at the job-card webhook.
5. Run the daily scan once manually, then activate.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Load Data & Build Queue

parameters.content:
## 📥 Load Data & Build Queue
Every morning at 9, vehicles, test-drive leads and the reminder log are loaded. Each vehicle and lead is checked for what's due, and anything already sent at that stage is skipped. The day's queue is capped at 150 messages.

## 🔧 Service & Insurance Reminders
Service is due by kilometres or months, whichever comes first, and free services are tracked separately. Insurance reminders go out at 30, 15, 7, 1 and 0 days. Urgent renewals also ping your insurance desk.

## 🚗 Test-Drive Follow-ups & Summary
GPT-4o-mini writes a short follow-up for days 1, 3, 7 and 14 after a test drive. A lead that's gone cold is flagged to its salesperson. The service manager gets a one-message summary of the day.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Job Card Sync & NPS Invite

parameters.content:
## 🧾 Job Card Sync & NPS Invite
When your DMS closes a job card, the service job is saved and the vehicle's last-service date and odometer are updated, which feeds the next reminder. Three hours later the customer gets a WhatsApp link to a short NPS survey.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – NPS Response & AI Analysis

parameters.content:
## 🧠 NPS Response & AI Analysis
The survey answer is matched to the job card. GPT-4o-mini reads the comment for sentiment, root issue and a recovery action, and the score is banded as detractor (0–6), passive (7–8) or promoter (9–10).

## 🤝 Recovery & Logging
Detractors trigger an email and WhatsApp to the service manager, plus a personal apology to the customer. Passives get a thank-you, and promoters are asked for a Google review. Every response is saved to the job and the NPS log.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
The vehicle and job sheets hold customer names, phone numbers and registrations, so keep them private. Protect the DMS webhook with Header Auth. Only message customers who agreed to WhatsApp updates.

values.content:
You are a friendly, non-pushy car sales consultant at an Indian dealership writing a WhatsApp follow-up after a test drive.
Step goals: day 1 = thank them and ask how the drive felt. Day 3 = share a helpful angle (an approximate EMI, finance options, an exchange bonus for their old car, variant comparison). Day 7 = a gentle nudge (a limited-period offer, booking amount, delivery timelines). Day 14 = a last friendly check-in leaving the door open.
Use their first name and the model. Max 380 characters, 1–2 emojis. End with an easy reply ("Reply 1 for a callback"). Never invent prices: if no budget is given, say "we'll share an exact on-road quote".
Return ONLY JSON: {"message": string, "salesperson_tip": string (max 140 chars)}
